messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PD-INC-4321 fired for inference-service-eu (error-rate spike, 5xx). Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.example/PD-INC-4321
Sasha (oncall): taking this, oncall working window. pinging Mike and Jen.
Mike L (eng): on my way, grabbing logs now. any customer impact noted?
Rohit (cs): we have two customers reporting timeouts on embeddings API in eu-west-1, CS is triaging but want ETA for customers.
Jen R (sre): checking autoscaler and queue depth. initial glance shows request queue backlog on k8s svc inference-eu-svc.
Sasha (oncall): can someone run `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-eu -o wide` and paste pod restarts?
Mike L (eng): pastebin with pod list: ```
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-eu-0                   1/1     Running   0          3d
inference-eu-1                   1/1     Running   0          3d
inference-eu-autoscaler-xyz     1/1     CrashLoopBackOff  4   2h
```
Jen R (sre): autoscaler crashloop explains backlog. looking at logs: `panic: nil pointer` in /cmd/autoscaler/main.go:116. Suspect recent config flag change.
Sasha (oncall): ok, that's a control-plane regression, not model runtime. Mike, can you temporarily scale the deployment to drain load? recommended: scale replicas to 6 while we fix autoscaler.
Mike L (eng): scaling now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-eu --replicas=6`
PagerBot: Deploy scaling action recorded by Sasha (oncall).
Jen R (sre): scaling effective, queue depth dropping, error-rate trending down. but autoscaler still crashing so risk of new pods not being added automatically.
Rohit (cs): sharing to impacted customers: "We see transient errors; we've applied a manual scale to stabilize capacity and are investigating root cause. ETA ~30-45m."
Sasha (oncall): I'll roll back the autoscaler config change from last deploy. Anyone who made that deploy? Mike?
Mike L (eng): that was my change, added `--enable-profiling` flag. reverting now and will push fix.
Mike L (eng): rollback applied: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/autoscaler autoscaler=autoscaler:v1.2.1`
Infra Watcher: autoscaler pods are restarting -> now `Running` with 0 restarts.
PagerBot: PagerDuty PD-INC-4321 acknowledged by Sasha (oncall).
Sasha (oncall): status: manual scale stable, autoscaler rollback successful, error-rate down to baseline. continuing to monitor for 15m.
Jen R (sre): capturing logs for postmortem: saved /var/logs/incidents/PD-4321-autoscaler.txt and created ticket INFRA-231.
Rohit (cs): updating customers: sending follow-up with mitigation and timeline.
Mike L (eng): will open PR to add unit test for nil-check in autoscaler and add canary on config flag.
Sasha (oncall): handoff plan: I'll keep this pinned for next 10m then hand to Mike for follow-up and postmortem write-up. Mike, if you're good to own the post-incident, say "i'll own postmortem".
Mike L (eng): i'll own postmortem.
PagerBot: PD-INC-4321 status changed: Resolved (manual). Closed by Sasha (oncall).
Sasha (oncall): closing notes: customer impact limited to 20m window, mitigated via manual scale and autoscaler rollback. Next steps: Mike to PR fix, Jen to validate rollback in staging, Rohit to complete CS comms. Great quick collaboration everyone :thumbsup:
Mike L (eng): thanks all. I'll drop a short RCA draft in #postmortems and link INFRA-231.
Jen R (sre): adding monitoring alert to catch autoscaler crashloop (alert if autoscaler restarts >1 in 10m).
Rohit (cs): marked customers as notified and will reopen if we get new reports.
Sasha (oncall): final check: anyone see residual alerts?
Jen R (sre): no residual alerts, metrics stable.
Sasha (oncall): ok, closing thread. good job. :party_popper:
